items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is a lift of an approximation datum B_0 across a nilpotent thickening to a finite type B fitting a commutative diagram with prescribed etale and complement-smoothness properties (source lines 2150-2252, label lemma-lift-approximation). The solver must identify the special-fibre square as a distinguished square, deform the etale leg by topological invariance of the etale site, build the pushout Y, and pin it down through base-change uniqueness of pushouts before reading off affineness and the diagram's properties; the pushout pin-down is the substantive step. Allowed background: the cited pushouts, etale and limits lemmas, delivered as navigation pointers.
